guarantees.claim: app_digest_done is driven to 0 and app_digest to all zeros whenever the valid output condition is not met (st != StAppWait or absorbed_i not true or lc_escalate_en_i true).

When st == StAppWait, absorbed_i is true (mubi4 strict) and lc_escalate_en_i is false (lc_tx strict), app_digest_done is set to 1 and app_digest[i] gets keccak_state_i[i][AppDigestW-1:0] for i = 0..Share-1.

assumptions.claim: keccak_state_i[i][AppDigestW-1:0] holds the valid final digest (masked shares if EnMasking) when the condition in G2 is true.
assumptions.cond: when app_digest_done is asserted (G2 condition true)
assumptions.risk: If SHA3 engine provides corrupted or premature state, a wrong secret/digest is forwarded to KeyMgr, potentially enabling key extraction or integrity failure.

uncertain_points.claim: Comment at line 753 states 'If !EnMasking, second is tied to 0.', but this always_comb block unconditionally reads keccak_state_i[1] when Share>1. The zeroing of the second share must be enforced elsewhere; if missing, a non-zero second share could leak secrets in non-masked mode.
uncertain_points.cond: When Share > 1 and EnMasking parameter is false.
uncertain_points.risk: Secret leakage or incorrect digest if the second share holds non-zero data in unmasked mode.
